messages:
marin_newhire: Morning! Quick checklist for week 1 — I fly in Sunday night and have a few things to confirm: I-9 verifier slot, whether my passport is ok for documents, how to claim the travel stipend from offer, and whether I need a printed W-4. Also my recruiter mentioned childcare support for orientation day  is that still a thing?

lina_peopleops: Hi Marin, welcome :wave: Passport is fine for I-9. We'll reserve a Section 2 verifier at 8:30am Mon at Security. No printed W-4 needed  submit electronically in Workday (Pay > Tax Withholding). For travel stipend: Concur with tag "Onboard-Travel" + your offer email as proof. Childcare: yes we can reimburse short-term childcare for orientation hours, upload receipts under Concur > Other with note "Childcare-Onboard".

marin_newhire: Awesome. For the I-9, can the verifier accept a passport plus a digital SSN card image? Or does the SSN need the physical card?

hr_bot: I-9 rule: acceptable documents are either a valid passport OR driver's license + Social Security card (physical). A digital image of an SSN card is NOT acceptable for Section 2. If you only present a passport that's sufficient.

omar_it: Laptop ETA Mon morning. We'll stage it at Reception if you arrive before delivery. Bring photo ID to pick up. I'll be at the IT desk 9-1 if you need hands-on setup. If you want VPN pre-provisioned DM me a scanned ID after you complete I-9 and we'll queue it.

badge_bot: Note: contractor/new-hire badge issuance requires Section 2 complete. Temporary visitor pass available immediately after verification. If you need early floor access before 10am, Lina will request pre-provision.

marin_newhire: Travel receipts  do I need manager sign-off before submitting? Recruiter approved in the offer but I don't have a separate email.

carmen_finance: If recruiter approved in-offer, that's sufficient. In Concur select expense type "Onboard-Travel" and attach the offer text. Reimbursement via payroll; expect payout within 2 pay cycles depending on cutoff. For airfare cap, policy is economy up to $650 unless manager pre-approves higher.

lina_peopleops: Checklist to copy: 
``
- Bring passport OR DL + SSN card for I-9 (passport OK alone)
- I-9 verifier: Mon 8:30am Security (we reserved)
- Laptop: pick up at Reception; IT drop-in 9am
- Benefits/W-4: submit in Workday on day 1 (30-day window for benefits)
- Travel stipend: Concur > Onboard-Travel + offer as proof
- Childcare: claim in Concur > Other with receipt and note "Childcare-Onboard"
``

marin_newhire: Perfect  thanks everyone. I'll upload receipts and see you Monday. :raised_hands:
